title: Skip One Delivery a Week. Here's What It Could Become 🍕 #shorts
description:
Guess: what could 15 € a week become by 67? Comment a number.

One 15 € delivery order a week (example) is 780 € a year, about 65 € a month. Invested from 16 at an assumed ~6 % a year (Finanztip planning value for broad world stock ETFs, monthly compounding, before tax and costs): by 30 you paid in 10,920 € and it could be about 17,000 €; by 67 you paid in 39,780 € and it could be about 262,000 € (about 95,000 € in today's money at 2 % inflation). Returns are not guaranteed; values go up and down, and the past is no promise.

Sources: Finanztip (6 % planning return for stock ETFs, Feb 2025); maths: monthly compounding

Not financial advice.
